# CI failures

Every CI failure, its cause and its fix, newest first. Check here before diagnosing a new one.
Owner: devOps. Get the log with `gh run view <run id> --log-failed`.

Since 450ef08 the let-go is registered the cycle after completion, and in that cycle the tracker watched only the old entry: a HOLD on the clock starting then, the launching edge, was missed, and SDA stayed low | in its registration cycle the tracker watches the new entry's clock (`t_*`) |
